caption:
The $300 no-receipt rule is gone.

For years you could claim up to $300 of work expenses without receipts. From 1 July 2026 that exception no longer applies, and neither does the $150 laundry one.

What replaced it: a standard deduction of up to $1,000 for work-related expenses, starting with the 2026–27 return. It's automatic for Australian residents who earn wages and it needs no receipts.

The catch: if you claim your actual expenses instead, each dollar reduces the $1,000 and the claims need records. So itemising only pays off when your real work costs add up to more than $1,000.

Union fees, donations and your tax agent's fee sit on top either way.

Did you know the $300 rule had ended?

#taxreturn #australiantax #taxdeductions #paylesslegally #ato
